description: A VRF of the router: a kernel VRF device of the document's name, its routing table and the links it holds. Other router kinds name it by its name; the default VRF, of every link no VRF holds, has no document.

interfaces.description: Links the VRF holds, by name or glob, a glob being a prefix followed by `*`; a glob stands for the links the node's Network documents name in a `[Match]` section's `Name=`. A link is named by a Network document, which gets `VRF=`, and every link of that Network is in this VRF.

table.description: Routing table of the VRF, which no other VRF uses; not 253, 254 or 255, the kernel's tables of the default VRF. A change creates the VRF anew, which ends the sessions in it.

title: VRF

rules.description: A VRF is named as its device, in 15 characters at most, and not default.
rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, n == "default" || size(n) > 15).map(n, "VRF " + n).join(", ") + ": a VRF is named as its device, in 15 characters at most, and default names the VRF of every link no VRF holds"

rules.description: A VRF's table is none of the kernel's own: 253, 254 and 255.
rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, documents[n].spec.table in [253, 254, 255]).map(n, "VRF " + n).join(", ") + " uses table 253, 254 or 255, which the kernel keeps for the default VRF; give it another number"

rules.description: A table belongs to one VRF.
rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(t, documents.map(n, documents[n].spec.table), "more than one VRF uses table " + string(t.filter(x, size(t.filter(y, y == x)) > 1)[0]) + "; give each VRF a table of its own")
rules.rule: cel.bind(t, documents.map(n, documents[n].spec.table), t.all(x, size(t.filter(y, y == x)) == 1))

rules.description: An interface or glob is in one VRF, once; globs compare as written.
rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(all, documents.map(n, documents[n].spec.interfaces).flatten(), "the interface " + all.filter(i, size(all.filter(j, j == i)) > 1)[0] + " is in more than one VRF, or twice in one; give each interface one VRF")
rules.rule: cel.bind(all, documents.map(n, documents[n].spec.interfaces).flatten(), all.all(i, size(all.filter(j, j == i)) == 1))

rules.description: No VRF holds an interface of Router.spec.management.interfaces; names and globs compare as written.
rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(held, documents.map(n, documents[n].spec.interfaces).flatten(), cel.bind(api, cel.bind(routers, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "Router" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].Router : {}), routers.map(k, routers[k].spec.management.interfaces == null ? [] : routers[k].spec.management.interfaces).flatten()), "the management interface " + api.filter(i, i in held)[0] + " is in a VRF, and chalkd answers in the default VRF alone; keep the node API's interfaces out of every VRF"))
rules.rule: cel.bind(held, documents.map(n, documents[n].spec.interfaces).flatten(), cel.bind(api, cel.bind(routers, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "Router" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].Router : {}), routers.map(k, routers[k].spec.management.interfaces == null ? [] : routers[k].spec.management.interfaces).flatten()), api.all(i, !(i in held))))

rules.description: While the node API answers on every interface, a Network document names a link that no VRF holds; names and globs compare as written.
rules.message: every link the Network documents name is in a VRF, and chalkd answers in the default VRF alone, on every interface while Router.spec.management.interfaces is null; keep the link you reach the router through out of every VRF
rules.rule: size(documents) == 0 || cel.bind(routers, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "Router" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].Router : {}), routers.exists(k, routers[k].spec.management.interfaces != null)) || cel.bind(held, documents.map(n, documents[n].spec.interfaces).flatten(), !cel.bind(nets, (("networkd.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "Network" in config["networkd.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["networkd.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].Network : {}), cel.bind(matches, dyn(nets.map(n, "match" in nets[n].spec ? (type(nets[n].spec.match) == list ? nets[n].spec.match : [nets[n].spec.match]) : []).flatten()), " " + dyn(matches.map(m, "name" in m ? (type(m.name) == list ? m.name : [m.name]) : []).flatten()).join(" ").replace("\t", " ") + " ")).matches("^( +(" + held.map(i, i.replace(".", "[.]").replace("*", "[*]")).join("|") + "|![^ ]*))* *$"))

rules.description: No NetDev document creates a device of a VRF's name.
rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(made, cel.bind(netdevs, (("networkd.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "NetDev" in config["networkd.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["networkd.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].NetDev : {}), netdevs.map(n, !has(netdevs[n].spec.netDev) ? [] : (type(netdevs[n].spec.netDev) == list ? netdevs[n].spec.netDev : [netdevs[n].spec.netDev]).map(s, has(s.name) ? s.name : "")).flatten()), "the VRF " + documents.filter(n, n in made)[0] + " takes the name of a device a NetDev document creates; rename the VRF or the NetDev")
rules.rule: cel.bind(made, cel.bind(netdevs, (("networkd.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "NetDev" in config["networkd.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["networkd.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].NetDev : {}), netdevs.map(n, !has(netdevs[n].spec.netDev) ? [] : (type(netdevs[n].spec.netDev) == list ? netdevs[n].spec.netDev : [netdevs[n].spec.netDev]).map(s, has(s.name) ? s.name : "")).flatten()), documents.all(n, !(n in made)))
